currentFocus: Preparing the October 27 Soft Alpha: chat, Whispers, Block, and Report are in, and moderation plus published Community Rules and Safety & Privacy pages complete the alpha social stack.

latestCompleted.summary: Whispers, Block, and Report: 1:1 character Whispers with durable unread, account-level Block with a Blocked Players list, and message and player reports that preserve evidence for review.

nextStep: Human review and playtest of operator moderation, sanctions, and in-game appeals; then player-to-player trading (#225) on the shared social and sanction seams.

Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
